schema_note: snr_details mirror: bibcode -> entries for inspection/tools. This script writes only this file (does not mutate papers-data.json). Top-level metrics.snr binary flags are unchanged. logSNR is a separate binary column and is not subtyped here.

2008ISTSP...2..793C.title: Multiscale CLEAN Deconvolution of Radio Synthesis Images

snr_details.scope: M51 noise sweep; theoretical image-plane SNR = clean-beam-convolved model peak / image-plane noise

execution_context.input_snr_setting: Swept image-plane SNR (flux accurate down to ~4; MEM fails near 100)

snr_details.evidence: Noise sweep defines theoretical image-plane SNR and studies flux-recovery thresholds: MEM overestimates at SNR as high as 100; CLEAN / Maximum Emptiness / Multiscale CLEAN remain accurate down to SNR ~4; Högbom stays usable even below SNR 1.

2012MNRAS.426.1223C.title: Sparsity Averaging Reweighted Analysis (SARA): a novel algorithm for radio-interferometric imaging

snr_details.scope: Example M31 reconstruction at 30% coverage (SARA); mean curves over 100 sims
snr_details.evidence: Primary fidelity metric is 20·log₁₀(σ_x/σ_{x−x̂}) dB. Example at 30% coverage: SARA 38.43 dB (M31) / 29.08 dB (30 Doradus) vs BP/TV/IUWT baselines.

snr_details.scope: Complex Gaussian noise on visibilities for all coverage sweeps

execution_context.formula: Same σ form with per-visibility noise std in denominator

snr_details.evidence: Complex Gaussian noise added at fixed 30 dB input SNR; 100 Monte Carlo runs per coverage.

snr_details.scope: SARA vs BP / BPDb8 / TV / IUWT across 10–90% coverage
snr_details.baseline: Directly run BP, BPDb8, TV, IUWT
snr_details.evidence: SARA highest mean reconstruction SNR at every coverage; >6 dB gain over every other method at 10% coverage (M31) and ≥3 dB elsewhere; ≥2 dB on 30 Doradus at every coverage.

2014MNRAS.439.3591C.title: PURIFY: a new approach to radio-interferometric imaging

snr_details.scope: Coverage sweep M/N=0.2–2 on M31 and 30 Doradus (mean of 30 sims)

execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Simulation (continuous off-grid Fourier + AMI coverage test)

snr_details.evidence: Primary fidelity metric is L₂ reconstruction SNR vs noiseless model. SARA has the highest mean SNR throughout both M31 and 30 Doradus coverage sweeps.

snr_details.scope: Fixed input visibility SNR for all PURIFY configurations
snr_details.evidence: Input visibility SNR fixed at 30 dB, distinct from the reconstruction SNR score.

snr_details.unit: dB (upper gap vs next-best on M31)
snr_details.scope: SARA vs RWBPDb8 / TV / RWTV / BP variants
snr_details.evidence: On M31, next-best RWBPDb8 remains as much as 4 dB below SARA; on 30 Doradus, TV/RWTV are at most 2 dB below SARA.

snr_details.scope: Early high-SNR CLEAN major cycles with visibility-block sparsification

execution_context.formula: Operational effective-SNR trade-off (not truth-based reconstruction SNR)
execution_context.input_snr_setting: DR ~1e4+; early cycles kept above noise floor

snr_details.evidence: Sparsification factor of 100 is argued to reduce SNR by 10× while leaving early cycles above the noise floor (schedule 100, 100, 30, 10, 1). Operational rationale, not a measured end-to-end reconstruction-SNR benchmark.

2024ApJS..273....3A.title: The R2D2 Deep Neural Network Series Paradigm for Fast Precision Imaging in Radio Astronomy

snr_details.scope: Generic 200-problem VLA simulation test; R3D3-6L best mean

execution_context.input_snr_setting: Gaussian visibility noise adapted to target image DR

snr_details.evidence: Linear S/N: CLEAN 13.6±3.6, uSARA 30.8±1.9, AIRI 31.3±2.3, R2D2 33.7±1.5, R3D3-3L 33.8±1.4, R3D3-6L 34.0±1.6 dB on the generic 200-problem test.

snr_details.scope: Learned-series methods vs AIRI / uSARA on matched simulated test
snr_details.evidence: Across R2D2 / R3D3, mean gain is 2.4–2.7 dB over AIRI and 2.9–3.2 dB over uSARA; end-to-end U-Net only 20.5±2.7 dB.

2024RASTI...3..505L.title: Scalable Bayesian uncertainty quantification with data-driven priors for radio interferometric imaging

snr_details.scope: QuantifAI MAP on Cygnus A (Table 1); MeerKAT synthesis-time sweep also reported
snr_details.evidence: Table 1 QuantifAI MAP SNR: W28 26.85, M31 27.48, 3C288 24.10, Cygnus A 30.25 dB. MeerKAT M31 MAP SNR rises 25.29→34.42 dB over 1–8 h synthesis.

snr_details.scope: QuantifAI MAP vs wavelet-based MAP across four images
snr_details.baseline: Wavelet-based sparsity MAP (Cai et al. 2018b style)
snr_details.evidence: QuantifAI MAP beats wavelet-based MAP by 1.9–12.7 dB (average ~7 dB) across the dataset.

2024arXiv240317905C.title: Scalable Non-Cartesian Magnetic Resonance Imaging with R2D2

snr_details.scope: MRI R2D2 validation sample at DR=167, AF=16 (Fig. 2)
snr_details.evidence: Primary metric is L₂ SNR vs ground truth. Example at AF=16: R2D2 18.44 dB, R2D2-Net (NUFFT) 19.39 dB, AIRI 15.55 dB, U-Net 14.93 dB.

snr_details.scope: R2D2 / R2D2-Net vs AIRI, U-Net, NC-PDNet across AF and iteration sweeps
snr_details.evidence: R2D2-Net (NUFFT) and R2D2 outperform AIRI/U-Net/NC-PDNet on SNR; Additional Acceleration Ratio table reports how much more undersampling R2D2 tolerates at matched SNR targets.

2024arXiv240318052A.title: R2D2 Image Reconstruction with Model Uncertainty Quantification in Radio Astronomy

snr_details.scope: Simulated test set Fig. 2; 3C 353 case study to 37.7 dB
snr_details.evidence: R2D2 converges to ~33 dB on the simulated test set; 3C 353 case study rises 35.0→37.7 dB across iterations 1→12.

snr_details.scope: R2D2 vs CLEAN, U-Net, uSARA (and qualitatively AIRI)
snr_details.baseline: CLEAN (~15.9 dB), uSARA (~19.5 dB), U-Net (~28 dB first iteration)
snr_details.evidence: Simulated test: R2D2 ~33 dB vs U-Net ~28, uSARA 19.5, CLEAN 15.9 dB. Paper states image estimation largely superior to CLEAN, U-Net, uSARA, and AIRI.

2025AJ....169..289W.title: A Decentralized Framework for Radio-interferometric Image Reconstruction

snr_details.scope: Simulated Sgr B2 / Sgr C; S/N tracked per major cycle (Fig. 5)

execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Simulation (Sgr B2, Sgr C); real data use Wasserstein instead

snr_details.evidence: S/N defined as 20·log₁₀ L₂ fidelity for simulated datasets with known truth; parallel and serial methods converge to comparable S/N across major cycles.

2025A&A...704A..43Y.title: Non-convex sparse regularisation for radio interferometric imaging via smoothly clipped absolute deviation

snr_details.scope: Messier 106 SKA sim at input S/N=35 dB (ISCAD)
snr_details.evidence: At input S/N=35 dB on Messier 106: ISCAD 34.63 dB vs LPG 34.40, AIRI 33.12, SARA 31.95. ISCAD highest S/N on all three test cases.

snr_details.scope: Noise-robustness Monte Carlo (100 realisations per point)

execution_context.formula: Input S/N swept; reconstruction S/N measured

snr_details.evidence: S/N and S/N_log vs input S/N (15–55 dB), 100 Monte Carlo realisations per point.

snr_details.scope: ISCAD vs SARA, AIRI, LPG across tests and noise sweep
snr_details.evidence: ISCAD attains the highest S/N on all three cases and across the 15–55 dB noise-robustness sweep.

2025ApJS..280...63A.title: Toward a Robust R2D2 Paradigm for Radio-interferometric Imaging: Revisiting Deep Neural Network Training and Architecture

snr_details.scope: Table 4 setup E2; R2D2_A2,T2 best model
snr_details.evidence: E2 benchmark: R2D2_A2,T2 31.2±2.4 dB; AIRI 28.3±3.1; uSARA 28.1±3.4; CLEAN 12.0±19.3 dB (diverged on 3 problems).

snr_details.scope: R2D2 models vs uSARA / AIRI on E2
snr_details.evidence: R2D2 models outperform uSARA/AIRI by roughly 2–4 dB in SNR on the harder E2 setup.

2025ChJSS..45.1597F.title: Imaging Method of Synthetic Aperture Radio Telescope Based on Minimax Concave Penalty

snr_details.scope: Simulated SKA array (MCP proposed); also 10%/50% undersampling tables

execution_context.formula: SNR in dB (reconstruction quality; formula not further specialized in notes)

snr_details.evidence: MCP SNR: 24.16 dB (10% undersampling), 27.78 dB (50%), 35.73 dB (SKA array) — highest in every tested condition.

snr_details.scope: MCP vs SARA and AIRI at 10%/50% undersampling and SKA array
snr_details.evidence: MCP exceeds SARA and AIRI on SNR in every condition (e.g. SKA: MCP 35.73 vs AIRI 34.52 vs SARA 32.83 dB).

2025MNRAS.537.1608T.title: The AIRI plug-and-play algorithm for image reconstruction in radio-interferometry: variations and robustness

snr_details.scope: cAIRI-OAID at ΔT=8 h (example); sweeps over 1–8 h
snr_details.evidence: At ΔT=8 h: MS-CLEAN 5.45, SARA 27.74, cAIRI-OAID 28.65 dB SNR. AIRI-family methods tracked across 1–8 h observation times.

snr_details.unit: dB over uSARA/SARA; >20 dB over CLEAN
snr_details.scope: AIRI / cAIRI vs uSARA / SARA / MS-CLEAN
snr_details.evidence: AIRI/cAIRI improve by 1–2 dB over uSARA/SARA counterparts and dramatically outperform CLEAN (>20 dB) across observation times.

2025MNRAS.542..426T.title: S-R2D2: a spherical extension of the R2D2 deep neural network series paradigm for wide-field radio-interferometric imaging

snr_details.scope: S-R2D2 Table 1 means over 60 test problems on the sphere
snr_details.evidence: S-R2D2 SNR 21.7±4.3 / 21.2±3.9 / 20.8±3.7 dB at Np=400²/600²/800²; planar R2D2 degrades from 6.6±1.5 to 1.9±1.5 dB over the same resolutions.

snr_details.scope: S-R2D2 vs planar R2D2 at matched resolutions
snr_details.evidence: S-R2D2 outperforms R2D2 by roughly 14–19 dB in SNR at matched resolutions.

2025MNRAS.542.2494M.title: Strong gravitational lensing with upcoming wide-field radio surveys

snr_details.scope: Conservative/optimistic lens discoverability criteria for DSA-2000 / SKA-Mid / VLASS forecasts

execution_context.formula: Total SNR of combined lensed images (literature threshold)
execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Forecast / simulation pipeline (not measured reconstruction SNR)

snr_details.evidence: Adopted discoverability limits require SNR_tot ≥ 20 (Collett 2015; Rezaei et al. 2022). POLISH demo is qualitative only — no reconstruction SNR tabulated for the network itself.

2025MNRAS.543.1727L.title: MROP: modulated rank-one projections for compressive radio interferometric imaging

snr_details.scope: Classical-model reference, VLA low-DR; MROP matches at D/N≈1

execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Simulation (VLA/MeerKAT); real VLA 3C 273 residual check without SNR

snr_details.evidence: Reference classical SNR: VLA low/high DR 30.73/28.50 dB; MeerKAT 30.13/27.95 dB. MROP matches classical-model SNR once D/N≈1.

snr_details.scope: MROP / BDA / CROP vs classical measurement model at matched data size
snr_details.evidence: Classical, BDA, CROP, and MROP converge to very similar SNR at D/N≈1; dropping D/N to ~0.38 costs 0.1–1.1 dB SNR depending on source/array.

snr_details.evidence: Primary metric is L₂ SNR (box-plots Figs. 5, 8, 9). Comparisons are among U-Net/GU-Net coverage-training strategies; no numeric CLEAN SNR table in the extracted notes.

snr_details.evidence: Training data use input SNR (ISNR) of 30 dB.

2025arXiv250721270M.title: Generative imaging for radio interferometry with fast uncertainty quantification

snr_details.scope: OOD 30 Doradus (DR~600); GU-Net RI-GAN
snr_details.evidence: OOD 30 Doradus: GU-Net RI-GAN 46.03 dB, U-Net RI-GAN 30.80 dB, CLEAN 32.55 dB. In-distribution SNR shown as boxplots (Fig. 3).

snr_details.evidence: GU-Net improves SNR over dirty/U-Net in-distribution and beats U-Net and CLEAN by a wide margin on OOD 30 Doradus (46.03 vs 30.80 / 32.55 dB).

2026ApJS..283....9T.title: HyperAIRI: A Plug-and-play Algorithm for Precise Hyperspectral Image Reconstruction in Radio Interferometry
